purpose: Define when an unlocked Contract Format 1.4 artifact/tree becomes eligible for `locked` status based on resolved semantics and passed validation rather than author confidence or file placement.

value.unlocked_rule: New/migrated/reconciled contracts remain `unlocked` while mandatory semantic or format gaps exist.
value.eligibility_rule: Lock eligibility requires all applicable mandatory validation gates for the artifact/tree to pass.
value.topic_rule: Required Topic membership/composition must be explicit/resolved.
value.format_rule: Artifact must conform to active Contract Format profile.
value.semantic_rule: No known unresolved machine-significant ambiguity may remain.
value.status_rule: Changing `unlocked` to `locked` is an explicit accepted change, not an automatic side effect of validation.
value.reopen_rule: A locked artifact may return to unlocked/candidate state for change without erasing prior accepted history.
